fields.description: Issue dated April 7, 1928 (Volotii 6, Numbler 11). Contains editorials and political commentary on local corruption, gambling, bootlegging, and an emerging "underworld" in Dade County; discusses the role of the grand jury and State's Attorney Vernon Hawthorne. Reports that recall petitions are circulating regarding city officials Sewell, Platt, and Knight, and includes commentary on organized labor and claims about attempts to sell the labor vote. Notes the Chamber of Commerce moving into new quarters and reports that the Southern Bank & Trust Company is expected to reopen. Includes local political notes, satirical "Late News Flashes," and substantial advertising and entertainment listings for Greater Miami and Miami Beach.
